shortDescription: SpaceX NASDAQ:SPCX disclosed on Friday that Google executive Donald Harrison has resigned from the rockets-to-AI company's board after more than a decade.Here are some details:

children: disclosed on Friday that Google executive Donald Harrison has resigned from the rockets-to-AI company's board after more than a decade.
Harrison notified SpaceX of his resignation on November 4, and it took effect immediately
The Elon Musk-led company said Harrison's decision to resign was not due to any disagreement with the company on matters relating to its operations, policies or practices
Harrison, a longtime executive at Google, is currently president of Global Partnerships and Corporate Development. Alphabet
is the ‌largest single institutional holder of SpaceX, according to LSEG data
Google on Friday reported a small increase in its position in SpaceX to about 555 million shares from 551.2 million earlier
